messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 6(2)

Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures. 2. The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to amend Annex I, after consulting the stakeholders concerned, in the light of technical progress, advances in knowledge or new scientific evidence by adding to the list of categories of machinery and related products in Annex I a new category of machinery or related products, withdrawing an existing category of machinery or related products from that list or moving a category of machinery or related products from one Part of Annex I to another Part of that Annex, in accordance with the criteria and the procedures laid down in paragraphs 4, 5 and 7 of this Article.

response.text:
Commission | isEmpoweredToAdoptDelegatedActs | delegated acts amending Annex I | in accordance with Article 47; after consulting the stakeholders concerned; in the light of technical progress, advances in knowledge or new scientific evidence | "The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 47 to amend Annex I, after consulting the stakeholders concerned, in the light of technical progress, advances in knowledge or new scientific evidence"
Commission | mayAddCategoryToAnnexI | a new category of machinery or related products | in accordance with the criteria and procedures in paragraphs 4, 5 and 7 of Article 6 | "by adding to the list of categories of machinery and related products in Annex I a new category of machinery or related products"
Commission | mayWithdrawCategoryFromAnnexI | an existing category of machinery or related products | in accordance with the criteria and procedures in paragraphs 4, 5 and 7 of Article 6 | "withdrawing an existing category of machinery or related products from that list"
Commission | mayMoveCategoryBetweenAnnexIParts | a category of machinery or related products from one Part of Annex I to another | in accordance with the criteria and procedures in paragraphs 4, 5 and 7 of Article 6 | "moving a category of machinery or related products from one Part of Annex I to another Part of that Annex"
